metadata.title: joinGIS
metadata.description: GIS infrastructure, territorial data and geostatistical analysis for public and private organizations.

hero.title: We turn territorial information into clear decisions.
hero.body: joinGIS brings together software, surveying and urban planning to build territorial data management platforms, technical reports and geostatistical analysis for governments, technical teams and private organizations.

stats.label: Territorial data pipelines built for day-to-day operations.
Technical reports and mapped outputs ready for decision-making.
Software, surveying and urban planning working as one delivery team.

platform.title: An operational base for reliable territorial data.
platform.body: We design environments to organize layers, registries, field surveys, indicators and reports in workflows that can be sustained over time.

sectors.title: We work with public agencies and private teams that need a better reading of territory.
sectors.body: The proposal is designed for municipalities, cadastre, planning, infrastructure and environmental areas, real estate developments and teams that rely on spatial data for decisions.

metadata.title: Services
metadata.description: GIS infrastructure, territorial reports and geostatistical analysis services.

intro.title: GIS capabilities to organize, analyze and communicate territorial data.
intro.body: We support projects from the initial technical structure to concrete products for management, diagnosis, reporting and decision-making.

items.title: GIS infrastructure
items.body: Design of databases, layers, services and workflows to manage geographic information with consistent technical criteria.

items.title: Territorial data management
items.body: Normalization, integration and maintenance of information from surveys, cadastre, records and open sources.

items.title: Territorial reports
items.body: Clear reports for technical teams, leadership, institutional presentation or communication with third parties.

items.title: Geostatistical analysis
items.body: Spatial variable crossing, indicators, distribution patterns and territorial reading to support decisions.

items.title: Territorial consulting
items.body: Support for public agencies and private organizations that need to turn scattered information into useful processes.

workflow.title: We organize the problem before building the solution.
workflow.body: We map sources, users, expected decisions and operational constraints. From there we define concrete deliverables: data, maps, reports, dashboard or platform.

metadata.title: About
metadata.description: A team combining software, surveying and urban planning to create GIS solutions.

intro.title: A technical team for complex territorial problems.
intro.body: joinGIS was born from the combination of software development, surveying and urban architecture. Our goal is to create practical tools to understand, manage and communicate territorial information.

team.name: Jovino Pereyra
team.body: Contributes territorial criteria, survey interpretation, cadastre knowledge and technical precision to structure reliable geographic information.

team.name: Romina Sol Naranjo
team.body: Integrates an urban planning perspective and spatial communication to turn data into understandable diagnoses and proposals.

team.name: Francisco Hanna
team.body: Designs and builds the platform, web infrastructure and technical flows that connect data, users and reports.

values.title: Territorial rigor
values.body: We prioritize consistent, traceable data that technical teams can use.

values.title: Operational clarity
values.body: Maps, reports and platforms should support decisions, not add complexity.

values.title: Progressive building
values.body: The value proposition evolves through real cases, concrete needs and learning with clients.
